_comment: WETH/USDC listing for monad-mainnet (token symbol WETH on Monad, checked on-chain 2026-10-12) (DEPLOYMENT.md §3; values from PARAMETERS.md). Read by script/ProposeListing.s.sol (LISTING=weth-usdc), which refuses zero addresses: the publisher addresses must still be filled in before proposing. Verified on Monad mainnet (chain 143) on 2026-10-11: underlying = WETH 0xEE8c…1242 (18 decimals, docs.monad.xyz token list); asset = native USDC 0x7547…b603 (6 decimals, Circle and docs.monad.xyz); settlement feed = Chainlink ETH/USD reference feed 0x1B14…0A04 (8 decimals, 1 h heartbeat, 0.05% deviation, path eth-usd); quote feed = Chainlink USDC/USD reference feed 0xf5F1…ebec (8 decimals, 1 h heartbeat, path usdc-usd). Both feeds were live with readable previous rounds; the -shared-svr 18-decimal variants are deliberately not used. USDC/USD rounds can be 3,606 s apart, so maxLegSkew stays well above 3,600. Pyth feed ids are Pyth's ETH/USD and USDC/USD (checked against Hermes 2026-10-07). maxLegSkew must cover the slower leg's heartbeat. insuranceSeed and keeperReserveMin come from the risk review (PARAMETERS.md §7) and must be non-zero. Amounts are in USDC's 6 decimals; strikes and caps in 1e18. ZERO-USDC LAUNCH: bootstrapFromFees = true lists with insuranceSeed and keeperReserveMin at 0 (no treasury deposits); insurance then fills from 60% and the keeper reserve from 10% of every fee. Until it has grown, a writer shortfall at expiry falls on that group's holders through the recovery ratio and keepers earn no USDC reward, so keep the short cap low and run the keepers yourself.
